title: Lillie Mae Morgan Mosley
clean_html:
Lillie Mae Morgan Mosley

Preserved Primary Document • morgan-l.htm

She married Wilbur MOSLEY who was born 1 September, 1882 and died 28 May, 1966. Wilbur was also a part of the mixed blood Cheswold community. Both are buried at the Fork Branch cemetary in Cheswold. Wilbur and Lillie Mae had the following children : Edna Mosley , married Charles Edward Marriott Jeanette Mosley, married Harold Marriott (two sisters marrying two brothers) Mildred Mosley, married Presley DURHAM Thelma Mosley Marie Mosley Frazier Mosley Roland Mosley, married Marie SAMMONS Thomas Mosley Raymond Mosley
